editorial_notes: amends was empty in the parsed tree (validator hard error); set by hand from the long title and section 2.

Sections 3 and 4 of this Act operate on Act No. 4 of 1999 ('the principal enactment' as that Act defines it), not on the Law; amendment_instructions targets_principal_enactment therefore point at Act 4 of 1999.
Section 4(2) prints 'an or alter March 10, 2001' and 'shall he deemed' (source typography); kept as printed.

body.heading: Short title.
body.raw_text: 1. This Act may be cited as the Apartment Ownership (Special Provisions) (Amendment) Act, No. 27 of 2002.
body.text: This Act may be cited as the Apartment Ownership (Special Provisions) (Amendment) Act, No. 27 of 2002.

body.heading: Replacement of section 3 of Act no 4 of 1999.
body.raw_text: 2. Section 3 of the Apartment Ownership (Special Provisions) Act, No. 4 of 1999 (hereinafter referred to as the "principal enactment") is hereby repealed and the following new section substituted therefor: Extension of Part 1 of the principal enactment.
body.text: Section 3 of the Apartment Ownership (Special Provisions) Act, No. 4 of 1999 (hereinafter referred to as the "principal enactment") is hereby repealed and the following new section substituted therefor: Extension of Part 1 of the principal enactment.

children.raw_text: 3. The provisions of Part I of the principal Enactment shall be in operation till December 31, 2003."
children.text: 3. The provisions of Part I of the principal Enactment shall be in operation till December 31, 2003."

body.heading: Retrospective effect.
body.raw_text: 3. The amendment made to the principal enactment by section 2 of this Act, shall be deemed for all purposes to have come into operation on March 10, 2001.
body.text: The amendment made to the principal enactment by section 2 of this Act, shall be deemed for all purposes to have come into operation on March 10, 2001.

children.raw_text: (1) A condominium plan relating to any condominium property owned by the Commissioner of National Housing or The National Housing Development Authority, required to be registered by a Registrar in terms of Section 6 of the Apartment Ownership Law, No. 11 of 1973, which is so registered during the period commencing on or after March 10, 2001 and ending on the day prior to the date of commencement of this Act, shall be deemed to have been validly registered in accordance with the requirements of the afore said action.

children.raw_text: (2) A certificate as is described in subsection (2) of section 2 of the principal enactment, issued under the hand of the Commissioner of National Housing or the General Manager of the National Housing Development Authority during the period commencing an or alter March 10, 2001 and ending on the day prior to the date of commencement of this Act, shall he deemed to have been validly issued in accordance with the requirements of the aforesaid section.

body.heading: Sinhala text to prevail in case of in consistency
body.raw_text: 5. In the event of any inconsistency between the Sinhala and Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text shall prevail.
body.text: In the event of any inconsistency between the Sinhala and Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text shall prevail.

amends_note: This Act amends the Apartment Ownership (Special Provisions) Act, No. 4 of 1999, not the Apartment Ownership Law directly: its long title reads 'AN ACT TO AMEND THE APARTMENT OWNERSHIP (SPECIAL PROVISIONS) ACT, NO, 4 OF 1999' and its section 2 replaces section 3 of that Act. The consolidated Apartment Ownership Law (LankaLaw HTML edition) lists 27 of 2002 in its chain header but carries no inline marker for it. Kept in this folder because the chain names it and because Act 4 of 1999 is itself an amending Act of the Law.
